name: Trendly Content Extractor – DOCX to WordPress Post Converter
author: Nitish Sharma

sections.description:
Trendly Content Extractor is the ultimate doc to post converter plugin for WordPress. Looking to import docx files and convert them into fully formatted WordPress posts? This powerful docx to wordpress solution does it automatically in seconds.

Why Choose Trendly Content Extractor?

Stop wasting hours copying and pasting from Microsoft Word. Our word to wordpress plugin is the fastest docx importer that transforms your .docx files into beautiful, SEO-optimized blog posts with a single click.

Powerful Features:

🔥 Smart Content Extraction
– Heading 1 becomes your post title automatically
– Heading 2 converts to proper <h2> tags for SEO
– Paragraphs, bullet lists, and formatting preserved perfectly

🖼️ Image Handling
– Extracts and uploads all images to your Media Library
– First image automatically set as featured image
– Inline images positioned correctly in content

🔗 SEO Boost
– Automatic internal linking for better search rankings
– Clean HTML output optimized for Gutenberg & Classic Editor
– Proper heading hierarchy for maximum SEO impact

⚡ One-Click Conversion
– Upload your .docx file
– Click “Extract Content”
– Get a ready-to-publish WordPress draft instantly

Perfect For:
– Bloggers migrating content from Word documents
– Content marketers doing bulk import of articles
– Publishers converting manuscripts to web format
– Anyone needing a reliable docx converter

WordPress Standards Compliant
Built with security and performance in mind. No external dependencies needed – uses native PHP ZipArchive and SimpleXML for safe word import processing.

Usage

Best Practices for Optimal Results:

📄 Document Setup
– Use Heading 1 for your post title
– Use Heading 2 for section headings
– Include paragraph text, bullet lists, and images as needed

🎯 Image Optimization
– The plugin automatically sets your first image as the featured image
– All other images are inserted inline, left-aligned within content
– Images are uploaded to your Media Library for easy management

⚙️ Internal Linking
– Automatic internal linking is conservative by design
– Prevents over-linking while boosting your site’s SEO
– Links are contextually relevant to your content
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “Trendly Content Extractor”
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/trendly-content-extractor/ directory
  3. Activate through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress

Quick Start

  1. Navigate to Trendly Content Extractor in your admin menu
  2. Select your desired post type
  3. Upload your .docx file
  4. Click Extract Content
  5. Edit and publish your new post!
sections.faq:
Is this a doc to post converter?

Yes! Trendly Content Extractor is specifically designed as a doc to post converter that transforms Microsoft Word (.docx) files into WordPress posts automatically.

Can I import docx files in bulk?

Currently, the plugin processes one file at a time for optimal quality control. Bulk import functionality is on our roadmap for future releases.

Does it work as a word to wordpress importer?

Absolutely! This plugin excels as a word to wordpress solution, preserving all your formatting, headings, and images during conversion.

Will it modify my existing posts?

No. The docx importer only creates new draft posts and never modifies or deletes your existing content.

What happens to my images during conversion?

All images from your .docx file are automatically extracted, uploaded to your WordPress Media Library, and properly placed in your post. The first image becomes your featured image.

Is my data safe? What happens on uninstall?

Your posts and media are completely safe. The uninstall routine only removes plugin-specific settings (if any). Your word import history and created content remain untouched.

Which file formats are supported?

The plugin supports .docx files only – the modern Microsoft Word format. Legacy .doc files should be saved as .docx before importing.

Does it work with both Gutenberg and Classic Editor?

Yes! The generated HTML is fully compatible with both the WordPress Block Editor (Gutenberg) and Classic Editor.

Are external libraries required?

No. The content extractor uses native PHP functions (ZipArchive and SimpleXML) for secure, dependency-free DOCX parsing.

Can I use this as an automatic post creator?

Yes! Once configured, the plugin acts as an automatic post creator – simply upload your document and a draft post is generated instantly.
